method: Original wasm executable operators; block/loop entry markers, synthetic function exits and overlapping address slices excluded. LLVM line/inline-caller attribution is compiler source attribution, not a unique causal cost; shared optimized work and boundary overhead remain explicit. IMUL helper bodies use dynamic caller context. Counters never timed. Exact accounting ON.

pairs.method: 30 warm +300 timed updates, 1 discarded +9 alternating fresh-instance pairs; accounting ON, profiling OFF; not guest frames or isolated CPU cycles.
